entitlements.text: You were owed free meals and refreshments while you waited
entitlements.basis: DGCA CAR Section 3 Series M Part IV, para 3.4.1: delays of 4+ hours qualify for any flight length

entitlements.text: You said you weren't given food. Mention this in your complaint
entitlements.basis: DGCA CAR Section 3 Series M Part IV, para 3.8.1(a)

entitlements.text: You can ask for another flight within 6 hours, or a full refund
entitlements.basis: DGCA CAR Section 3 Series M Part IV, para 3.4.2 (domestic flights delayed more than 6 hours)

entitlements.text: If your flight was due to leave between 8 PM and 3 AM, you can also ask for a free hotel stay
entitlements.basis: DGCA CAR Section 3 Series M Part IV, para 3.4.3

entitlements.text: A delay by itself doesn't qualify for cash compensation
entitlements.basis: DGCA CAR Section 3 Series M Part IV, para 3.7.1: cash compensation only for denied boarding and cancellation

entitlements.text: None of this applies if the delay was caused by weather, air traffic control or other events outside the airline's control
entitlements.basis: DGCA CAR Section 3 Series M Part IV, paras 1.4, 1.5, 3.4.4
